```plato

// The shape of a periodic test or synthesis waveform. Pulse carries its
// duty cycle: the high fraction of each period.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Waveform)
type Waveform
    = Sine
    | Square
    | Triangle
    | Sawtooth
    | Pulse(DutyCycle: Proportion);
```
